faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to our team.

trial.q: Do you offer a free trial?
trial.a: Yes — every paid plan includes a 14-day free trial with full feature access. No credit card required.

switch.a: Absolutely. Upgrade, downgrade or cancel from the billing portal anytime. Changes are prorated to the day.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept all major credit cards, ACH, SEPA direct debit and wire transfer for Enterprise plans.

data.a: We offer EU (Frankfurt) and US (Virginia) data residency. Enterprise customers can choose dedicated regions.

security.a: Yes. We're SOC2 Type II certified, GDPR compliant, encrypt data in transit and at rest, and never train shared models on your data.

integrations.q: Does it integrate with my ATS?
integrations.a: We integrate natively with Greenhouse, Lever, Workday and BambooHR, plus a full REST API and webhooks.

discount.q: Do you offer non-profit or startup discounts?
discount.a: Yes — 50% off for registered non-profits and qualifying early-stage startups. Contact us to apply.

cancel.a: You keep access until the end of your billing period. Your data is exportable in CSV/JSON for 30 days.

support.q: What kind of support do you offer?
support.a: Community support on Free, email on Starter, priority on Pro, and a dedicated CSM with 1-hour SLA on Enterprise.

onboarding.a: All plans get our guided onboarding. Pro and Enterprise include white-glove migration from your current ATS.

checks.title: Compliance checks
checks.desc: SOC 2, GDPR, and security controls evaluated against your tenant.

accessControl.name: Logical access controls
accessControl.desc: Restricts logical access to information assets, systems, and data to authorized users only.
accessControl.evidence:
Role-based access control (RBAC) enforced across all endpoints.
MFA enabled for 100% of admin accounts.
Quarterly access reviews performed on {date}.

encryption.name: Encryption at rest and in transit
encryption.desc: All sensitive data is encrypted using industry-standard algorithms in transit and at rest.
encryption.evidence:
TLS 1.3 enforced on all public endpoints.
AES-256 encryption for database storage and object storage.
Key rotation every 90 days via KMS.

monitoring.name: Security monitoring and anomaly detection
monitoring.desc: Continuous monitoring of systems for security events, anomalies, and intrusion attempts.
monitoring.evidence:
Centralized SIEM with 24/7 alerting.
90-day hot retention, 365-day cold retention.
Last 30 days: 0 critical incidents, 4 medium, 18 low.

changeMgmt.name: Change management and deployment controls
changeMgmt.desc: Changes to production systems follow documented review, testing, and approval workflows.
changeMgmt.evidence:
All production changes require peer review and CI pipeline validation.
Deployment logs retained for 365 days.
Last deployment: {date}.

vendorRisk.name: Vendor and third-party risk management
vendorRisk.desc: Identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks from third-party vendors with access to data.
vendorRisk.evidence:
Active vendor inventory: 47 vendors.
14 vendors pending SOC2 review.
Last assessment cycle: Q3 2025.

records.name: Records of processing activities
records.desc: Maintains a comprehensive record of all processing activities involving personal data.
records.evidence:
Article 30 register up to date with 23 processing activities.
Data Protection Officer appointed and registered with supervisory authority.
Last review: {date}.

security.name: Security of processing (Art. 32)
security.desc: Implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure data security.
security.evidence:
Encryption, access controls, and pseudonymization implemented.
Regular penetration tests (last: {date}).
Employee security training: 98% completion rate.

dsar.name: Data subject access & erasure requests
dsar.desc: Process and respond to data subject access and erasure requests within 30 days.
dsar.evidence:
Average DSAR response time: 4.2 days (SLA: 30 days).
12 DSARs processed this quarter — 11 completed, 1 in progress.
No overdue requests.

privacyByDesign.name: Privacy by design and by default
privacyByDesign.desc: Privacy principles are embedded into processing activities and business practices.
privacyByDesign.evidence:
DPIA performed for all new features handling personal data.
Data minimization applied across candidate and resume services.
3 DPIAs completed in the last quarter.

tls.name: TLS configuration and certificate health
tls.desc: All public endpoints use valid TLS certificates and follow current best practices.
tls.evidence:
All certificates managed via automated ACME/Let's Encrypt.
TLS 1.0/1.1 disabled; only TLS 1.2+ allowed.
HSTS enabled with 1-year max-age.

mfa.name: Multi-factor authentication enforcement
mfa.desc: Privileged users must authenticate using multiple factors to access sensitive systems.
mfa.evidence:
MFA enforced for 100% of admin users.
8.5% of regular users have MFA enabled (target: 60%).
SSO providers supported: Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace.

backup.name: Backup and disaster recovery
backup.desc: Regular backups are performed and verified through periodic restore drills.
backup.evidence:
Automated daily backups with 30-day retention.
Last successful restore drill: {date} (RPO: 24h, RTO: 4h).
Cross-region backup replication enabled.

secrets.name: Secrets management hygiene
secrets.desc: Secrets are stored in a managed vault with rotation and no plain-text exposure in code.
secrets.evidence:
All secrets stored in HashiCorp Vault with audit logging.
Last secret rotation: {date}.
0 secrets detected in code repositories (GitHub secret scanning enabled).

auditLog.name: Audit log integrity and retention
auditLog.desc: Audit logs capture all administrative actions and are tamper-resistant.
auditLog.evidence:
Append-only audit log with cryptographic chaining.
Retention: 365 days hot, 7 years cold.
Last integrity verification: {date} — all checks passed.

vuln.name: Vulnerability scanning
vuln.desc: Regular vulnerability scans are run against infrastructure and dependencies.
vuln.evidence:
Weekly automated scans (Snyk + Trivy).
Last scan: {date} — 2 medium findings, 0 high/critical.
Mean time to remediate critical: 2.3 days.
